description: Gestionnaires d'assainissement collectif is a dataset listed in Opendata Isère open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de l'Isère. Établissements publics étant compétent en matière de gestion de l’assainissement collectif sur le département de l'Isère. Ayant au moins une des compétences: collecte, transport, épuration. Coverage: Isère. The portal files it under Environnement - Agriculture - Eau. Its keywords are Eau, gestionnaire, assainissement, collectif. The portal shows 100 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-isere-fr-portal.
